systems.tiers: Serves the Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs, His Majesty's Correctional Services and the Royal Eswatini Police Service; at completion stage in February 2024, launch announced for the end of March 2024; no stations named

note: The speech names a case management system shared by justice, corrections and the police without saying what the police do in it or that stations record in it; it also lists Buhleni police station among capital projects to be completed.
